title: Risk‑budgeted scheduled model rotation with shadow validation and safe-pause
author: Carmen Liu
release_notes: Adds scheduled rotation controller that consumes per-model risk budgets, introduces shadow validation job and safe-pause policy. Opt-in via feature flag 'rotationRiskBudgets'.
description:
Context and motivation:
We need a safer, schedule-driven way to rotate models (e.g., nightly/weekly rotates of model variants) while keeping strict operational guarantees for production customers. Existing canary and shadow systems handle ad-hoc rollouts, but scheduled rotations introduced two operational gaps: (1) long-running rotations can consume risk budget without an automated way to pause or back off if observability signals degrade, and (2) shadow validation runs were ad-hoc and not integrated with the rotation controller.

This PR implements a risk-budgeted scheduled rotation controller plus a shadow-validation pipeline that runs lightweight, representative traffic against candidate model variants before traffic swap and can auto-pause rotations if safety gates exceed thresholds. The design focuses on minimal blast radius, observable decision points, and a clear opt-in path (FeatureFlag: rotationRiskBudgets).

Highlights / what this changes (high level):
- New controller: rotation_scheduler.Controller that consumes rotation schedules from ModelServeConfig and a per-model "risk_budget" token bucket.
- Shadow validation job (batch): validates sampled production traffic against candidate model variants and computes quality delta metrics (latency, failure_rate, semantic-diff) stored in /api/rollouts/validation-results
- Safe-pause policy: if metric gates (configurable) exceed thresholds or risk budget is drained beyond low-water mark, controller pauses subsequent rotations and triggers an alert + automatic rollback hook.
- New metrics and traces: rotation.scheduled.attempts, rotation.scheduled.pauses, rotation.shadow.validation.latency_p50/p95, rotation.risk_budget.tokens_remaining
- Opt-in flag: rotationRiskBudgets (default off for now).

Checklist (implemented):
- [x] rotation controller loop + schedule parsing
- [x] risk budget accounting and token leak detection
- [x] shadow validation runner + lightweight comparator (semantic diff via embedding cosine similarity configured per-model)
- [x] alerting hook for pause/rollback (integrates with existing alerting pipeline)
- [x] unit + integration tests (controller, budget accounting, validator)
- [x] docs snippet and console feature flag exposure

Commits (summary):
- feat(rotation): add rotation scheduler core and risk budget accounting
- feat(validation): shadow validation runner and comparator library
- docs: add rotationRiskBudgets feature flag docs and operational runbook
- test: add unit tests for budget accounting and integration test for pause path
- ci: add e2e stage to exercise shadow validation pipeline in integration cluster

Files changed (high level):
- services/rotation/scheduler.go (new) -- core controller loop and scheduler state machine
- services/rotation/budget.go (new) -- token bucket implementation and persistence hooks
- jobs/shadow_validation/runner.py (new) -- lightweight runner that replays sampled request payloads to candidate models
- api/rollouts/validation_results.go (new) -- store and expose validation run summaries
- ops/alerting/rotation_rules.yaml (updated) -- alert rules for pause/rollback triggers
- console/featureflags.json (updated) -- expose rotationRiskBudgets flag to admins
- docs/ops/rotation-runbook.md (new) -- operational runbook for scheduled rotations

Review conversation (selected):
- Maya Thompson (review): "The budget accounting looks solid, but I'm worried about a race between scheduled rotate job and manual rollback via the console. If a human triggers a rollback while a scheduled rotate is draining tokens, we could end up double-rolling. Can we add an idempotency/lease on ModelServeConfig to serialise manual+scheduled operations?"
- Carmen Liu (author): "Good catch. Added a lease token (scheduler.go) that is acquired before rotation and released after success/failure. Manual rollback path now consumes the same lease and will preempt a scheduled rotation only after acquiring the lease. See scheduler.go lines ~120-180."
- Arjun Patel (review): "Please add metrics for lease acquisition latency and failures — we need visibility if manual ops are being blocked. Also confirm persistence is strongly consistent across replicas."
- Carmen Liu: "Added rotation.lease.acquire_latency metric and made the lease backed by the persistent lock table (consistent write). Note in docs that short lease TTL (30s) prevents long holds, and we surface 'lease_blocked_by' attribute in traces."
- Liam O'Neill (approver): "Verified in staging: scheduled rotation + shadow validation ran end-to-end for a small model. No regressions observed. Approving."

CI summary:
- build: pass
- unit tests: pass (coverage for new packages 86%)
- integration e2e: initial run failed due to a flaky network test (jobs/shadow_validation/runner.py had an edge-case for timeout backoff). Re-ran the e2e stage and it passed.
- lint: pass

Operational notes and safety considerations:
- Default behaviour is opt-in. Feature flag is off in global config; Customer-specific flags can be turned on per-tenant via Console.
- The risk_budget token bucket is seeded from ModelServeConfig.risk_budget_daily (configurable per-model). Ops can top-up or drain budgets via the new API endpoints (admin-only).
- Shadow validation is intentionally lightweight: uses sampled requests (1-2% sampling default) and runs comparator thresholds defined per-model to avoid false positives from data drift.
- A paused rotation emits a detailed validation summary and attaches the last successful candidate id to the alert for quick rollback.

Backward compatibility:
- All changes are additive. Existing canary and ad-hoc shadow routes are unaffected. Existing cron-based pipelines will continue until opt-in is enabled.

Follow-ups (future work):
- Add automated model rollback that can replay failing validation requests for debugging (ENG-4290)
- Provide a console UI for viewing live risk budgets per-model and historical depletion graphs
- Add more semantic metrics (embedding-based k-nearest drift detection) to shadow validation comparator

Merge outcome:
- PR merged via squash on 2025-01-17 after approvals and green CI. Release gated behind feature flag; no immediate traffic changes.
